Author: Serpens66
Name: AIV Placement Lobby
Description: Shows offline AIV placement fits in the skirmish lobby and selects a random best-scoring AIV for multiplayer hosts.

Changes: Restrict AIV placement evaluation and lobby UI hooks to the actual multiplayer setup screen, including Coop Trails opened through Customize.
Preserve Vanilla Coop Trail selection and restore the exact prior ready-button state when leaving a lobby.
Render placement tooltips on a fully opaque high-contrast background.
Enlarge status markers and add a dark outline so yellow partial-fit markers remain visible on the lobby background.
Build the no-prebuild lobby snapshot with Vanilla's normalized keep-start state instead of treating serialized starts as blocking buildings.
Resolve NoRot from each keep's map-facing direction and rebuild earlier AI starts sequentially before checking later players.
Reuse the multiplayer best-score tie choice for both sequential checks and the actual game start.
Scale placement-status tooltips with the game's frontend resolution and UI-scale formula.
Log every evaluated AIV rotation with score, fit percentage and first blocking issue for native-result diagnosis.
Show Complete, Partial, Impossible and NotEvaluable markers with localized tooltips in the AIV selection list.
Own the extended AIV/AIC selection UI and allow up to 999 selected AIVs in both single-player and multiplayer.
Block the multiplayer host ready/start actions while current checks are pending and randomly choose only among exact best-fit ties at game start.
Evaluate every selected AIV candidate asynchronously in native import order and aggregate the deterministic best fit.
Cache map snapshots and placement results with bounded, file-invalidated keys including advopt_pre_build and the analyzer version.
Log cache behavior and separate parse, snapshot, projection and rule timings while discarding stale generations on the main thread.
Capture selected map, AI player slot, keep assignment, AIV candidates, initial rotation and advopt_pre_build on every relevant lobby generation.
Keep prebuild mode explicitly NotEvaluable until sequential support is implemented, and reject stale generations by identity.
